responsibility: Turns abstract MIR drop semantics into explicit drop control flow and drop-flag updates by combining move-path dataflow with MIR patching, including handling conditional drops, drop-and-replace, and dead unwind edges.
same_name_distinction: This `elaborate_drops.rs` is the actual MIR transform pass that runs dataflow, finds dead unwinds, allocates drop flags, and patches a body to elaborate drops. The utility file of the same name provides the reusable generic drop-elaboration machinery that this pass drives.
